recommended_path.one_liner: Cheapest, simplest, addresses root cause directly via single-knob flag change; preserves existing corpus + chat template + lr/scheduler config; ~$20-30 + 8-13h wall; clean A/B vs current Path A.

contingency_tree.B_succeeds: land verdict, declare Path A mitigated, proceed to F2/F3/F4 axis injection (per A' decision §6.2)
contingency_tree.B_partial: pivot to Track A combo (r=16 + 70/30 mix) for next cycle
contingency_tree.B_fails: drop to r=8 (one more flag flip, $20-30) — hard floor before LoRA stops being meaningful
contingency_tree.r8_also_fails: pivot to Track A (corpus-bias hypothesis becomes dominant)

falsifier.primary_criterion: Δ_TriviaQA ≥ 0pt vs Llama anchor (EM 0.514) AND paired bootstrap 95% CI lower ≥ −0.5pt AND McNemar p > 0.05
falsifier.composite_gate: F1_v3 ≠ CHAT_FAIL_v3 (no STRONG regression on any task)

failure_modes.MITIGATION_FAIL_REGRESSION: primary criterion fails — TriviaQA still STRONG-regressed → escalate per contingency tree
failure_modes.MITIGATION_FAIL_NO_LIFT: primary passes but secondary fails on both HellaSwag+MMLU → over-regularized; back off (e.g. r=16 → r=24)
failure_modes.MITIGATION_PARTIAL: primary passes (Δ ≥ −0.5pt non-significant McNemar) but Δ_TriviaQA still slightly negative AND secondary passes → declare partial; consider track combo

falsifier.lock_status: BINDING before any mitigation re-train kicks off; modifications post-eval require new dated spec doc
falsifier.eval_pipeline_reuse: directly reusable per docs/p9_a_prime_eval_pipeline_landed_2026_05_03.ai.md §6 — no code changes, just env var pointing at new hub repo

honest_c3_caveats.label: track_scoring_subjective
honest_c3_caveats.summary: 5-axis weighted rubric uses author-assigned weights (C1=0.20, C2=0.25, C3=0.25, C4=0.15, C5=0.15); different reasonable weights yield different rankings (e.g. C5=0.30 promotes EWC to 1st-2nd)

honest_c3_caveats.label: regression_cause_multi_factor
honest_c3_caveats.summary: catastrophic forgetting via r=64 capacity is dominant hypothesis but not only one; alternatives include chat-template artifact, corpus distribution shift, eval prompt formatting interaction, 4-bit quantization noise — Track B may underperform if root cause is corpus-bias not capacity-bias

honest_c3_caveats.label: mitigation_chat_lift_tradeoff
honest_c3_caveats.summary: all 4 tracks introduce regularization that constrains chat-axis specialization; no a-priori guarantee Pareto-optimal point exists with both Δ_TriviaQA ≥ 0 AND Δ_HellaSwag ≥ +0.5pt — falsifier secondary criterion explicitly accepts 'no lift' as partial success

honest_c3_caveats.label: single_seed_evaluation
honest_c3_caveats.summary: all eval uses seed=42 (per A' spec §2.5); LoRA training has stochastic data shuffling → seed swings ~0.5-1.5pt on TriviaQA possible; mitigation success at exactly Δ=0 might be seed-luck → if landing in [−0.5, +0.5] band, 3-seed amend recommended (3x cumulative cost)
